analysis:
The 2010 National Tiger Assessment, released by the Ministry of Environment and Forests on 28 March 2011, estimated India's wild tiger population at 1,706, using camera-trap and sign-survey methods introduced in 2006.

The subsequent 2014 assessment reported 2,226 tigers, an increase of about 30.5 per cent over the 2010 figure, and later cycles reported further increases.

The figure of 1,706 released in 2011 is consistent with the subsequent government estimates.
